raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The default decode graph ceiling reads 8, 48, 32, 256 up the memory tiers, so a 46 GiB L40S or A40 runs decode eager above batch 32, earlier than a 24 GB card. Related to #33483.

## Modifications

The 35 to 60 GiB tier defaults to 128 when tp_size < 4. The test checks the ceiling never drops as memory grows. It fails on main. I left the 20 to 35 GiB tier to #40346.

## Accuracy Tests

No model or kernel code changed.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

L40S, SGLang 02b983603d34c6af09e554ed2b8bf8d85290d9ae, closed loop, 128 in and 256 out. Output tokens/s of ceiling 128 over the default, one run each except the 8B (two, within 0.2%):

| Model | C=32 | C=48 | C=64 | C=128 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Qwen3-8B | +0.1% | +2.3% | +2.1% | +1.7% |
| Qwen3-4B | -0.4% | +3.3% | +3.3% | +2.4% |
| Qwen3-1.7B | +0.2% | +32.5% | +21.0% | +6.4% |
| Qwen3-0.6B | +0.2% | +119% | +90% | +31% |

The 8B gains about 2%, and the 0.6B more than doubles at C=48 (median TPOT 10.9 to 4.8 ms). Ceiling 128 costs the 8B 0.19 GB of graph memory, 0.9 s of capture and 1.0% of KV tokens.

```
python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path Qwen/Qwen3-8B [--cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 128]
python -m sglang.benchmark.serving --backend sglang --dataset-name random --random-input-len 128 --random-output-len 256 --random-range-ratio 1.0 --max-concurrency C --request-rate inf --num-prompts N --flush-cache --seed 1
# N = max(128, 4*C), 8*C for the 1.7B and 0.6B
```

Not measured: open-loop arrivals, A100-40GB, speculative decoding.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+class TestDecodeCudaGraphCeilingByMemoryTier(CustomTestCase):
+    def _resolve_decode(self, gpu_mem_mb, tp_size, max_bs=None):
+        args = ServerArgs(
+            model_path="dummy",
+            tp_size=tp_size,
+            mem_fraction_static=0.8,
+            cuda_graph_config=CudaGraphConfig(decode=PhaseConfig(max_bs=max_bs)),
+        )
+        with (
+            patch(
+                "sglang.srt.arg_groups.memory_hook.use_mla_backend",
+                return_value=False,
+            ),
+            patch(
+                "sglang.srt.arg_groups.memory_hook.get_device_memory_capacity",
+                return_value=gpu_mem_mb,
+            ),
+        ):
+            handle_gpu_memory_settings(args)
+        return resolution_result(args, "cuda_graph_config").decode
+
+    def test_ceiling_never_drops_as_memory_grows(self):
+        """A larger GPU must not get a smaller default ceiling, or decode batches
+        between the two ceilings run eager only on the larger GPU."""
+        gib = (16, 24, 35, 40, 45, 48, 60, 80, 96, 192)
+        ceilings = [self._resolve_decode(g * 1024, 1).max_bs for g in gib]
+        self.assertEqual(ceilings, sorted(ceilings), dict(zip(gib, ceilings)))
+
+    def test_default_ceiling_for_35_to_60_gib(self):
+        cases = (
+            # (reported MiB, tp_size, expected decode max_bs)
+            (35 * 1024, 1, 128),
+            (46068, 1, 128),  # L40S, A40
+            (60 * 1024 - 1, 1, 128),
+            (60 * 1024, 1, 256),
+            (46068, 4, 160),
+        )
+        for gpu_mem_mb, tp_size, expected in cases:
+            with self.subTest(gpu_mem_mb=gpu_mem_mb, tp_size=tp_size):
+                decode = self._resolve_decode(gpu_mem_mb, tp_size)
+                self.assertEqual((decode.max_bs, decode.bs[-1]), (expected, expected))
+
+    def test_explicit_ceiling_is_kept(self):
+        decode = self._resolve_decode(46068, 1, max_bs=64)
+        self.assertEqual((decode.max_bs, decode.bs[-1]), (64, 64))
+
+
